notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He is listed probable on the official report with a right wrist sprain. He has 12 or more rebounds in each of his last four games, including 29 points and 14 rebounds in 34 minutes Sunday, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic and Keyonte George.
notes.Bam Adebayo: He played 33 to 34 minutes in each of his last two games and faces a Utah frontcourt missing Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic. Miami-Utah has the highest total on the slate, but Miami is a 9.5-point favorite.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He has played only 29 minutes in each of his last two games because Boston pulled away early, sitting the whole fourth quarter Sunday. Boston-Philadelphia is lined as a close game (1.5 points), which points to a fuller workload.
notes.Franz Wagner: Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs are both out again, and Orlando runs its offense through him. He has played 38 to 40 minutes in each of his last four games, with 30 points and 11 assists in an overtime game Saturday.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He had 29 points and 13 rebounds in 34 minutes Saturday at Cleveland and has double-digit rebounds in each of his last four games. Josh Hart is questionable (right ankle soreness), but the 16.5-point spread brings blowout risk.
notes.Jalen Brunson: He scored 33 and 31 points in his last two games. New York is a 16.5-point favorite over Milwaukee, so a blowout could cut his fourth quarter.
notes.Darryn Peterson: Keyonte George is out with a right ankle sprain, which hands Peterson more of the point guard work. He scored 21 and 26 points in his last two games, playing 30 and 35 minutes.
notes.Isaiah Collier: Keyonte George is out with a right ankle sprain, and Collier is in our projected starting five next to Darryn Peterson. He played 16 minutes off the bench Sunday, so his minutes are the question.
notes.Mo Bamba: Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic are out, so Bamba is a backup big behind Jaxson Hayes. He has played 15 to 18 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games, with 10 rebounds on Nov. 4.
notes.Brice Sensabaugh: He has played only 10 to 14 minutes off the bench lately. His shots go up if Lauri Markkanen (questionable, right wrist sprain) sits, since Keyonte George is already out.
notes.Lauri Markkanen: He is questionable with a right wrist sprain after missing Sunday, when Josh Green started in his place. Before that he scored 21 to 24 points in each of his three previous games.
notes.Leaky Black: Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons are out, and both Domantas Sabonis (left knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (right wrist soreness) are questionable. Black played 40 minutes in his Nov. 6 start and 20 off the bench Sunday, so his role grows if either sits.
notes.Malik Monk: He has played 18 to 30 minutes off the bench in his last four games. Sacramento could be short with Domantas Sabonis and Keegan Murray both questionable.
He has played 33 to 42 minutes in each of his last six games and had 32 points and 10 assists Sunday with Domantas Sabonis out. Sabonis is questionable again tonight.
notes.Dylan Cardwell: He started Sunday with Domantas Sabonis out and had nine rebounds in 18 minutes. Sabonis is questionable again, and Maxime Raynaud is out.
notes.Ryan Dunn: He has played 23 minutes in each of his last two games but scored three points Monday. Phoenix is on the second night of a back-to-back, and its injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Khaman Maluach: He has played 18 to 22 minutes off the bench in every game since losing his starting job on Nov. 5, with 11 points Monday. Phoenix is on the second night of a back-to-back, and its injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Devin Booker: He scored 32 points in only 29 minutes Monday in a 26-point loss to San Antonio. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and Phoenix has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He has played 15 to 20 minutes behind Neemias Queta in his last four games and had 12 points and seven rebounds in 18 minutes Sunday. Boston-Philadelphia is lined as a close game.
notes.Jaylen Brown: He faces Boston, his former team, for the first time. He has scored 20 or more points in each of his last four games while playing 33 to 37 minutes.
notes.Joel Embiid: He had 18 points and 10 rebounds in 29 minutes Sunday. Adem Bona is out again, so Jabari Walker is the backup center.
notes.Tyrese Maxey: He had 27 points and seven assists in 36 minutes Sunday and has played 32 to 36 minutes in each of his last four games.
notes.Davion Mitchell: He has started and played 38 to 43 minutes in each of his last three games, with 10, eight and 11 assists.
notes.Brayden Burries: He has started Milwaukee's last four games at point guard, including 21 points and 11 rebounds in 38 minutes on Nov. 6. Tyler Herro is questionable (right contusion), which could open more ball-handling.
notes.Desmond Bane: He missed Nov. 7 with an illness and is not on tonight's injury report. Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs are out, so Orlando needs his scoring.
notes.Anthony Black: He left late on Nov. 7 holding his ankle after 18 points, eight rebounds and six assists in 38 minutes, but he is not on tonight's injury report. Jalen Suggs is out again.
notes.Tristan da Silva: He started Nov. 7 with Paolo Banchero out and played 39 minutes. Banchero is out again tonight.
notes.Jamal Cain: He played 36 minutes off the bench on Nov. 7 with Desmond Bane out and had 18 points and 12 rebounds. Bane is not on tonight's injury report, which likely cuts Cain's minutes.
notes.Darius Garland: Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram are out. He had 24 points and 10 assists in 32 minutes Sunday.
notes.Brook Lopez: He has started three straight games and scored 20 points in each of the last two. Phoenix plays on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Jaylin Williams are all out, so Oklahoma City leans on him even more. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Damian Lillard: Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe are out, so Lillard carries Portland's backcourt. This game is off the main slate.
notes.Jaime Jaquez Jr: He started Sunday but scored four points in 23 minutes. Tyler Herro is questionable (right contusion), and Jaquez is one of the players who would take on more if Herro sits.
